findings.claim: The metadata-safe diagnostic fix is incomplete: GetPropertyIdentifierLocation still indexes DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0], despite its contract saying it returns null for metadata properties. If a property on a closed generic value type from a referenced assembly reaches the BothStringAndIntKeyAreNull path, constructing the diagnostic throws IndexOutOfRangeException before ReportIfLocatedInCompilation can filter it, so the generator/analyzer can still crash.

receipt_plan.detail: Run Receipts.GeneratedTests.MetadataSymbolDiagnosticLocationTests.MetadataMemberWithInvalidKey_DoesNotCrashGeneratorOrAnalyzer. The library property has [Key((string?)null)], forcing the BothStringAndIntKeyAreNull path while its symbol is metadata-only in the app compilation. On this head the test observes the generator/analyzer crash instead of completing without CS8785 or AD0001.
